params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: request  Priority: P2
Summary: When the partner API fails to create a vehicle, the platform mails the office a raw PHP stack trace. The office cannot tell from it which garage or car is affected, what went wrong, or whether it has to do anything.

## What is wrong

`VehicleApiController::store` sends "Stocklist Api error" to `mail.api_error_recipient` (the office address) with the exception message, file, line and the full trace (over fifty frames of vendor paths). The mail of 31 October 2026 (see #1058) was a single slow bucket request, but nothing in it says so: not the garage, not the car, not that the vehicle was rolled back, not whether anyone has to act.

## What is asked

An internal mail in Dutch, in the house style of the other office notifications (like the bell report): a subject that names what happened and for which garage, the facts (garage, car, chassis number, time), the cause in plain words, what it means (the vehicle was not created; the partner got an error back), and what to do about it. The technical detail stays available but short and at the bottom; the full trace is already in the log.

Source: Portal mail:37.
params.title: The API error mail to the office is a raw stack trace
